question:
What is the core philosophy difference between utility-first (Tailwind) and component-based (Bootstrap) frameworks?
```html
<!-- Tailwind: utility-first -->
<button class="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-500 rounded">Click</button>

<!-- Bootstrap: components -->
<button class="btn btn-primary">Click</button>
```
options: Tailwind uses utilities, Bootstrap encapsulates components
Bootstrap is purely HTML, Tailwind purely CSS
explanation: Utility-first applies granular utility classes; component-based frameworks provide semantic component classes (btn, btn-primary).

question:
In Bootstrap's 12-column grid, how many columns does col-md-6 span? ```html
Half width on medium+
Half width on medium+
```
explanation: col-md-6 = 6 out of 12 columns = 50% width on medium breakpoints and up.

question:
How do Tailwind responsive prefixes control breakpoint styling? ```html
Responsive widths
```
options: Applied only at specified breakpoints and up
explanation: Tailwind uses mobile-first prefixes; md: applies from medium breakpoint and up, lg: from large and up.

question:
Why might framework CSS have high specificity, making overrides difficult?
```css
/* Framework rule */
.btn.btn-primary { background: blue; } /* specificity 0,0,2,0 */

/* User override */
.btn-primary { background: red; } /* specificity 0,0,1,0 */
```
explanation: Framework specificity (0,0,2,0) beats user specificity (0,0,1,0); to override, match or exceed framework specificity.
CSS-in-JS enables scoped, component-local styles and runtime variable control; complements or replaces CSS frameworks.
BEM (Block-Element-Modifier) naming convention creates explicit, non-cascading selectors; `.card__title--active` is self-contained, preventing accidental overrides.

question:
What is the primary risk of framework bloat in production?
```html
<button class="btn">Single utility</button>
<!-- Full framework loaded even if only this is used -->
```
explanation: Frameworks include many utilities; if only a few are used, unused CSS bloats the file; PurgeCSS/tree-shaking helps but requires configuration.

options: Theming centralizes changes, prevents specificity wars
explanation: Theming (via variables/tokens) updates all components consistently; overrides are fragile and lead to specificity escalation.

question:
How do utility classes in Tailwind improve developer velocity? ```html
Content
```
options: Faster to write than custom CSS
explanation: Utilities eliminate separate CSS authoring, reduce mental overhead, and speed up prototyping.

question:
What trade-off does adopting a framework like Bootstrap introduce?
```html
<!-- Bootstrap opinionated design -->
<div class="container"><div class="row"><div class="col-md-6">...
```
options: Reduced CSS writing, increased HTML markup
explanation: Frameworks shift complexity from CSS files to HTML markup; they reduce CSS but increase HTML boilerplate and HTML/CSS coupling.
